# Personio

Read Personio people, employment, attendance, absence, project, document, and employee-attribute data.

Category: Recruiting & HR. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/personio/.

## Actions

- **List Absence Periods** (read-only): Return v2 absence periods filtered by person, absence type, IDs, date-time bounds, or update time.
- **List Absence Types** (read-only): Return the v2 absence types configured for the company, including IDs, names, categories, and units.
- **List Attendance Periods** (read-only): Return v2 attendance periods filtered by people, projects, status, attribution dates, time bounds, or update time.
- **List Document Categories** (read-only): Return the legacy Personnel Data document categories and IDs used to classify or filter company documents.
- **List Documents** (read-only): Return v2 document metadata for one owner, optionally filtered by category and creation date.
- **List Employee Attributes** (read-only): Return the standard and custom employee attributes readable by the connected integration, including the keys accepted by list employee…
- **List Employee Records** (read-only): Return legacy Personnel Data employee records with selectable standard or custom attributes and incremental-update filtering.
- **List Person Employments** (read-only): Return employment records for one v2 person, including status, type, and working-hours details.
- **List Persons** (read-only): Return current v2 person summaries, optionally filtered by identity, status, or creation and update times.
- **List Projects** (read-only): Return v2 time-tracking projects filtered by IDs, names, codes, status, hierarchy, or top-level membership.
